blocks.html: RLC Residences, the residential division of real estate giant Robinsons Land Corporation, officially marks 2021 its most awarded year to date as the recipient of major distinctions from notable and prestigious award-giving bodies across the region.

At the recently held FIABCI Philippines Property and Real Estate Awards, two of RLC Residences’ top-notch developments were awarded gold recognitions in the High-Rise Residential Category. The Magnolia Residences, located at the mixed-use Robinsons Magnolia Complex, received the Gold Award for NCR. Following that, AmiSa Private Residences in Cebu bagged the same award for the Visayas region.

For leading the growth of RLC and changing the game in the real estate industry, Robinsons Land Corporation’s President and CEO, Mr. Frederick D. Go, received the 2021 Prix D’Excellence Award Property Man of the Year at the same event.

In his acceptance speech, Go expressed his gratitude for the brand’s wins, “It is an honor to be your Property Man of the Year. This is an award that is, and will always be, a result of the dedicated and collective teamwork of our people at Robinsons Land. At RLC, we continuously strive to create shared success with every Filipino through the projects we build, the communities we shape, and the sustainable practices we promote. This will fuel RLC Residences to keep building dreams so Filipinos can live their best lives.”
Meanwhile, Robinsons Land Corporation was hailed Philippines Developer of the Year by the DOT Property Awards 2021 for its premier projects.

On top of what’s called the biggest honor in the country’s real estate, its prestigious development, The Residences at The Westin Manila Sonata Place, was commended Best Luxury Condo while their new property in the East, Sierra Valley Gardens, took home the Best Mid-Rise Condo Development award.

More RLC Residences standout properties in and out of the Metro have also been honored at the 9th PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards (Philippines). The region’s leading real estate awards program awarded The Magnolia Residences as one of the country winners and was recognized in the Best Mega Mixed-Use Architectural Design category at the PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards 2021.

Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager John Richard Sotelo was delighted upon receiving the recognitions, “Robinsons Land Corporation always tries its best to live up to its purpose of building beautiful and well-designed condominiums for everyone. This award is an affirmation that we’re achieving and we’re succeeding in our goal. This is also going to push us to keep on doing better so please do look out for more exciting projects to come from us as we go on.”

RLC Residences also received Special Recognitions in ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and Sustainable Design and Construction for their green practices and other socially responsible initiatives such as community service, waste management, and eco-friendly design features.

Highly commended distinction in the Best Lifestyle Developer category is also given to RLC Residences. On the other hand, The Sapphire Bloc and Galleria Residences are recognized for Best High-End Condo Development in Metro Manila and Metro Cebu. Furthermore, SYNC and The Residences at The Westin Manila Sonata Place are also acknowledged for the Best Condo Architectural Design and Best Condo Interior Design categories, respectively.

This new brand went above and beyond its measures, determined to make its stakeholders proud by producing only the best of developments in the real estate market. It may be closing in on 2021 with heads held high, RLC Residences continues to find more innovative and sustainable ways to uphold the Raise-Live-Connect lifestyle as they enter another year breaking new grounds in the industry.
